records.content: hostssh asset gate follows redirects from API /. A 302 from api / to electronicmailservices.com makes the gate parse marketing HTML and request /_next/* against the API container, failing every deploy with five 404s even when production is healthy. Permanent fix: JSON descriptor at API GET /. Do not restore a marketing redirect at API root. After the 2026-08-23 A1 deploy, /readyz is degraded solely because of 67 historical failed send jobs (static, zero waiting, stub-mode leftover) — clear them or real failures hide. A1 remaining after deploy: MX/SPF/DKIM on shared domains, e2e dogfood, dev docs, SDK methods.
